subject: Medilink: Quality monitoring kickoff & implementation plan
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medilink.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Medilink: Quality monitoring kickoff & implementation plan

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to get your quality monitoring (prompt sets + eval harness + regression alerts) live in staging before the production cutover. Below is a compact plan and a few asks so we can scope the implementation window this week.

Core objectives
- Integrate prompt suite and baseline evals into your staging env
- Wire regression alerts and a canary rollout (thresholds below)
- Agree on a rollback policy and on-call/SLAs for early incidents

Asks from Medilink team
1) Confirm staging API credentials and the test dataset subset (we typically need a 2–5k sample) — sample-dataset-list.csv attached
2) Point of contact for SSO/KMS if you want Private deployment keys (Ava Li?)
3) Preferred 4-hour window for eval harness integration (we can do 11/23 or 11/24)

Redwood proposed thresholds (staging canary)
- Latency regressions: +30% increase in median latency triggers warning; +60% triggers automatic rollback
- Semantic regression (prompt suite pass rate): drop of 7 percentage points = alert; drop of 12 points = rollback consideration
- Confidence/aberrant-response ratio: >10% of responses flagged by eval heuristics => pause and investigate

Deliverables well push to the Drive folder once credentials are confirmed:
- initial-prompt-suite.csv (attached)
- eval-harness-integration-checklist.md
- MAP (mutual action plan) PDF with dates and owners (Medilink-MAP-v1.pdf attached)

Next steps
- Please confirm staging creds and whether Ava is the SSO/KMS contact by EOD Monday (11/22)
- If 11/23 works for the 4-hour integration window, well book Eng (Rishi) and CS (Marissa)

Thanks — well keep the first rollout conservative and fast-fail friendly.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: medilink-initial-prompt-suite.csv, Medilink-MAP-v1.pdf

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medilink.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Li <ava.li@medilink.com>, Contracts Team <contracts@medilink.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:06:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Medilink: Quality monitoring kickoff & implementation plan

Neha —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers below and a small attachment with the chosen test subset.

1) Staging creds: we will provision a read-only API key for the harness. Ive asked our infra team to send it to you via the secure channel (should arrive Mon morning).
2) SSO/KMS: Ava is the right contact; I CCd her here. For now well use our staging KMS key; we may switch to your KMS integration later in the Private deployment.
3) Integration window: 11/23 09:00–13:00 PT works for us. Please confirm the exact start time and expected hosts.

Regarding thresholds — the rollback numbers look fine; wed like a one-hour grace period after a regression alert to allow live mitigation steps unless the failure is catastrophic.

Attachment: sample-dataset-list.csv (IDs and redaction notes).

Samir
VP Product | Medilink Health
samir.patel@medilink.com

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 06:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Medilink: Quality monitoring kickoff & implementation plan

Neha / Rishi —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick internal notes before the 11/23 window:

- Rishi: please plan to run the eval-harness integration checklist (Ill drop the checklist link in the Drive folder) and validate tokenization/encoding parity on the staging model.
- Canary settings: I agree with Nehas thresholds but propose we add a secondary guard: if semantic pass rate drops by 5 points AND automated BLEU-like metric drops by 4 points within the same hour, immediately disable the canary and revert to previous model variant.
- Alerts: route regression pager to oncall@redwood.com for the first 72 hours, then switch to Medilink escalation path once the MAP moves to production.
- Rollback play: automated rollback + notification email to Medilink owners + runpoint to open a Jira (project MED-QMON) with incident tags.

Ill own the initial post-integration sanity checks and will run two smoke evals (prompt coverage and hallucination heuristics) at T+30m and T+180m.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Samir / Ava —

Great — thanks for confirming. Finalized plan and MAP items below; Ive also dropped the checklist and the initial prompt suite into the shared Drive folder. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_medilink-qmon

Finalized 11/23 window
- Start: 09:00 PT (Redwood infra team oncall + Rishi leading integration)
- Duration: 4 hours (integration + smoke runs)
- Post-integration checks: Marissa will run the T+30m and T+180m smoke evals

Confirmed guards & rollback process
- Latency: +60% = immediate rollback; +30% = warning and 1-hour mitigation window
- Semantic pass rate: -12 pts = rollback; -7 pts = alert + 1-hour mitigation window
- Secondary metric: combined semantic/BLEU drop (5 + 4) = immediate rollback per Marissa's note
- Rollback actions: automated model switch, open Jira MED-QMON-<timestamp>, notify Medilink POC and oncall@redwood.com

Authors & action owners
- Staging creds + secure delivery: Medilink infra (Samir/Ava)
- Eval harness integration: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood Eng)
- Post-integration smoke & regression monitoring: Marissa Cole (Redwood CS)
- MAP ownership: Neha Kapoor (Redwood CS) & Samir Patel (Medilink)

Please confirm when the staging API key has been shared to the secure channel and well proceed to start at 09:00 PT.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth first pass.

Neha Kapoor
